servo_supply.rule: torque and speed at 6.62 V: rested 7.36 V at 20% charge less 0.74 V sag at the pack's 132 A continuous rating; stall current at the charge-limited 8.2 V (4.1 V per cell)

bec.note: built into the flight controller; its mass is in the BOM with the FC

current_sense.basis: 40 A/V over 3.3 V at 12 bits (STM32F405 ADC, 12-bit; the ST page was not readable this round)

assumptions: Section polar e387-film: cd factor 1.2 for film over ribs: an assumption with no published source
Motor rotor inertia estimated from mass and diameter; not published.
Battery internal resistance estimated from claimed C rate; not published.
Servo current is the SPEC M8 estimate: stall current x (torque / stall torque), idle if published.
Tail polar is an assumed thin plate.
Gear trains mix steel pinions or gears with acetal mates of the same module; each gear is held to its own published rating.

Twist servo at the elbow drives the hand wing through a mtube-tigertitanium-ti3al2.5v-6.35x5.54 tube; M7 checks its torsion against the published minimum yield through von Mises (tau = sigma_y / sqrt 3).
Twist horn linkage ratio is geometry: the servo's published torque and speed are scaled by it; linkage backlash and compliance not modelled.

Round 5: servos run straight off the 2S pack, charged to 4.1 V per cell, so the pack presents at most 8.2 V: torque and speed from the published rows at 6.62 V, stall current at 8.2 V, all inside the published rows (no scaling). charged to 4.1 V per cell (8.20 V): capacity fraction 0.861, the lower of the model's rested curve (0.911) and the published 0.861 (Battery University BU-808 Table 4 read linearly between its 4.06 V (81%) and 4.13 V (90%) rows (our arithmetic); BU-409 Table 2 gives 90% at 4.10 V; the lower is used)

Round 5: the crank-speed governor and the 34 A drive-current clamp run in our controller on the flight controller at 960 Hz, reading the crank angle from the sensor-rls-orbis-br10 (14-bit; speed from 2-sample differences) and the battery voltage from the FC's sense input (0.01692 V resolution); the duty computed at one tick is applied at the next (one period of latency, held in between). The ESC is assumed to apply the commanded duty linearly; the clamp is a duty limit from measured speed and voltage with the motor's published Kv and resistance (its resistance at temperature is not modelled).
Round 5: the twist schedule takes the crank phase from the same encoder (last sample advanced at the measured speed); the servo PWM refresh is not modelled.
One crank pin drives both couplers; the left wing flies its own mirrored linkage (left-right stroke difference in design.packing).
Round 5: fixed stroke, half-swing 38.0 deg: the coupler pins are pinned in the rockers (no slot, no stroke servo); thrust and lift are set by stroke frequency and twist.

Rigid elbow: the outer spar is bonded into the inner one (spigot); round 5 removes the arm wing's own twist (twist weight 0 at the elbow), so the arm wing flies at its fixed incidence and only the hand wing twists.
Derived parts: pitot-static probe (bases in the structure list); pitot pressure lines counted in the 15% margin with the wiring.

Round 5: every drive joint has its own rated bearing, bushing or rod end (structure.joints states which force each reacts); loads combine at every step in the flight model, as magnitudes (directions not credited). The motor's own bearings carry the first pinion and are reported, not checked (no published rating). Shafts, pins and the plates' bearing seats are not checked.

Stroke envelope measured by flight test in calm air at a fraction of the gear, spar, coupler, servo and bearing ratings (control.envelopeAllowance: a rough-air allowance, a design choice); M7 judges full ratings on the flown loads.

packing.checker: sims/avis-shared/model.js prepare/layoutParts/fitReport (film workstream), used as is
slides: receiver moved 1 mm along x from its mass lump to fit
packing.placeholder: the film checker places a stroke servo unconditionally: a massless placeholder keeps a servo-sized box free that nothing fills (src/design/fit.js packingView)

control.dtRule: round 4: the step at which M4 peaks converge (half step changes them < 10%), not the 60-steps-per-cycle rule

envelopeAllowance.note: fraction of each rating the calm-air envelope may use, leaving the rest for rough-air load increments; M7 judges the full rating against the loads of the flights themselves

selection.basis: explicit round-5 parameters (ROUND5, ROUND5_OPT in the script and --set/--opt) on Larus v12; screen not rerun

performance.method: src/physics/scenarios.js runClimb: closed loop with the flight controller, its stroke envelope and current limit; climb from 15 s to 45 s of steady climb, no wind, battery full; best over commanded climb rates 0.5-3 m/s
performance.for_environment: the corridor can be re-solved to this climb with a margin: a gradient at speed V is climb / V
